outcome: Postpartum Quality of Life (PQoL) tool scores
International Consultation on Incontinence Questionnaire-Urinary Incontinence Short Form (ICIQ-UI SF) scores
pelvic pain with sexual intercourse scores
cohort: The cohort consisted of 534 postnatal women, with an average age of 32 years, who were recruited before hospital discharge and included a mix of nulliparous and multiparous women with various delivery types.
finding: While the suite of Patient-Reported Outcome Measures (PROMs) demonstrated sensitivity in detecting changes in postpartum well-being over time, it did not consistently discern differences based on morbidity (maternal or neonatal) or delivery type.
mod_finding: The PROM suite did not consistently discern differences in postpartum well-being scores based on delivery type.
